sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: European beech (Fagus sylvatica) is a large deciduous tree native to Europe, often 30–40 m tall, with a broad crown.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: In spring, hanging male catkins and inconspicuous female flowers appear on the same tree. The triangular beechnuts occur in pairs inside a spiny cupule.

sections.title: Food use and caution
sections.text: Beechnuts are eaten after preparation or cooking. Raw or immature seeds can cause illness if eaten in quantity.
